	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = aov_adv_magical_fortress_lvl }
		value = var:aov_adv_magical_fortress_lvl

}

	value = 100
	if = {
		limit = { aov_adv_magical_fortress_level >= 1 }
		value = 200

		limit = { aov_adv_magical_fortress_level >= 2 }
		value = 400

}

# The level in progress (var:aov_adv_working_level, 1-3)
aov_adv_months_needed = {
	value = 24
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = aov_adv_working_level }
		if = {
			limit = { var:aov_adv_working_level >= 2 }
			value = 36
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:aov_adv_working_level >= 3 }
			value = 48
		}
	}
}
aov_adv_months_left = {
	value = aov_adv_months_needed
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = aov_adv_progress }
		subtract = var:aov_adv_progress
	}
	min = 0
}
aov_adv_progress_percent = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = aov_adv_progress }
		value = var:aov_adv_progress
		multiply = 100
		divide = aov_adv_months_needed
	}
	max = 100
}
